verdict.rationale: A probe shows Graphite serves agent-readable markdown versions of its docs (get-started.md returns HTTP 200) with a documentation index pointing agents to an llms index. However, the canonical graphite.com/llms.txt returns 404, and the llms index lives on a Mintlify subdomain rather than the main site. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the canonical root domain, first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents consume them well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://graphite-58cc94ce.mintlify.site/docs/llms
